env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir y/exp
mkdir y/zimp
cp x/go.mod y/go.mod
cp x/exp/exp.lgo y/exp/exp.lgo
cp x/aimp/imp.lgo y/zimp/imp.lgo
mkdir z/dep/exp
mkdir z/app/imp
cp x/exp/exp.lgo z/dep/exp/exp.lgo
cp x/aimp/imp.lgo z/app/imp/imp.lgo

cd twin
logos run .
! stdout 'FAIL'
cp stdout ../twin.txt
cd ..

cd x
logos run .
! stdout 'FAIL'
cmp stdout ../twin.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout ../../twin.txt
cd ../..

cd y
logos build ./exp
logos run .
! stdout 'FAIL'
cmp stdout ../twin.txt
cd ..

cd z/app
logos run .
! stdout 'FAIL'
cmp stdout ../../twin.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout ../../../twin.txt
cd ../../..

-- twin/go.mod --
module example.com/twin

go 1.27

-- twin/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type Left struct{ N int }

type Right struct{ S string }

func (l Left) Name() string { return "left" }

func (r Right) Name() string { return "right" }

type Choice interface {
	Left | Right
	Name() string
}

type Scalar interface {
	int | string
}

type Nilable interface {
	int | []int
}

type Holder struct {
	C Choice?
}

func Pick(i int) Choice? {
	switch i {
	case 0:
		return Choice(Left{N: 7})
	case 1:
		return Choice(Right{S: "r"})
	}
	return nil
}

func FindU(ok bool) Scalar? {
	if ok {
		return Scalar(5)
	}
	return nil
}

func Slice(ok bool) Nilable? {
	if ok {
		return Nilable([]int(nil))
	}
	return nil
}

func Describe(c Choice?) string {
	if c != nil {
		return c.Name()
	}
	return "absent"
}

func Wrap(c Choice?) Holder {
	return Holder{C: c}
}

func report(name string, ok bool) {
	if ok {
		fmt.Println("ok", name)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("FAIL", name)
}

func main() {
	report("pick-left", Describe(Pick(0)) == "left")
	report("pick-right", Describe(Pick(1)) == "right")
	report("pick-absent", Describe(Pick(2)) == "absent")
	report("absent-nil", Pick(2) == nil)
	report("present-not-nil", Pick(0) != nil)
	var local Choice? = nil
	report("local-absent", Describe(local) == "absent")
	local = Choice(Left{N: 1})
	report("local-member", Describe(local) == "left")
	held := Wrap(Pick(1))
	report("field-roundtrip", Describe(held.C) == "right")
	if c := Pick(0); c != nil {
		report("narrowed-method", c.Name() == "left")
	}
	scalar := FindU(true)
	report("scalar-coalesce", fmt.Sprint(scalar ?? "none") == "5")
	report("scalar-absent", fmt.Sprint(FindU(false) ?? "none") == "none")
	report("scalar-present", scalar != nil)
	report("nilable-present-nil", Slice(true) != nil)
	report("nilable-absent", Slice(false) == nil)
}

-- x/go.mod --
module example.com/ord

go 1.27

-- x/exp/exp.lgo --
package exp

type Left struct{ N int }

type Right struct{ S string }

func (l Left) Name() string { return "left" }

func (r Right) Name() string { return "right" }

type Choice interface {
	Left | Right
	Name() string
}

type Scalar interface {
	int | string
}

type Nilable interface {
	int | []int
}

type Holder struct {
	C Choice?
}

func Pick(i int) Choice? {
	switch i {
	case 0:
		return Choice(Left{N: 7})
	case 1:
		return Choice(Right{S: "r"})
	}
	return nil
}

func FindU(ok bool) Scalar? {
	if ok {
		return Scalar(5)
	}
	return nil
}

func Slice(ok bool) Nilable? {
	if ok {
		return Nilable([]int(nil))
	}
	return nil
}

func Describe(c Choice?) string {
	if c != nil {
		return c.Name()
	}
	return "absent"
}

func Wrap(c Choice?) Holder {
	return Holder{C: c}
}

-- x/aimp/imp.lgo --
package imp

import (
	"fmt"

	a "example.com/ord/exp"
)

func report(name string, ok bool) {
	if ok {
		fmt.Println("ok", name)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("FAIL", name)
}

func Run() {
	report("pick-left", a.Describe(a.Pick(0)) == "left")
	report("pick-right", a.Describe(a.Pick(1)) == "right")
	report("pick-absent", a.Describe(a.Pick(2)) == "absent")
	report("absent-nil", a.Pick(2) == nil)
	report("present-not-nil", a.Pick(0) != nil)
	var local a.Choice? = nil
	report("local-absent", a.Describe(local) == "absent")
	local = a.Choice(a.Left{N: 1})
	report("local-member", a.Describe(local) == "left")
	held := a.Wrap(a.Pick(1))
	report("field-roundtrip", a.Describe(held.C) == "right")
	if c := a.Pick(0); c != nil {
		report("narrowed-method", c.Name() == "left")
	}
	scalar := a.FindU(true)
	report("scalar-coalesce", fmt.Sprint(scalar ?? "none") == "5")
	report("scalar-absent", fmt.Sprint(a.FindU(false) ?? "none") == "none")
	report("scalar-present", scalar != nil)
	report("nilable-present-nil", a.Slice(true) != nil)
	report("nilable-absent", a.Slice(false) == nil)
}

-- x/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/ord/aimp"

func main() {
	imp.Run()
}

	imp.Run()
